traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report covers the initial validation study's relative trueness (Bland-Altman) results, Table 3 (page 2/14), which is the primary/canonical method comparison study for the Listeria Precis Enumeration method (certificate UNI 03/05-09/06). The 'All cat.' row (n=110, bias -0.05) was excluded as a summary/aggregate row, not a distinct category. Note the report also contains a separate extension study (section 4.2.4, Table 13, pages 36-37) with two additional inoculation modalities (Pour plate and Surface spreading) tested on different matrices (Liver pâté, Raw milk, Fish terrine, Mashed potatoes, Mixed salad, Process water) - these are from an extension/renewal study using different food types and were not included per instructions to only record the primary/canonical study; those per-modality tables are: Pour plate (MP n=15 bias 0.02 SD 0.30 CI -0.64/0.69; DP n=18 bias -0.05 SD 0.20 CI -0.48/0.38; SP n=19 bias -0.05 SD 0.27 CI -0.62/0.52; V n=15 bias -0.07 SD 0.27 CI -0.66/0.53; CF n=17 bias -0.07 SD 0.21 CI -0.52/0.38; ES n=15 bias -0.01 SD 0.15 CI -0.34/0.31) and Surface spreading (MP n=15 bias 0.02 SD 0.36 CI -0.77/0.82; DP n=17 bias -0.01 SD 0.19 CI -0.41/0.40; SP n=17 bias 0.08 SD 0.19 CI -0.33/0.50; V n=16 bias 0.01 SD 0.23 CI -0.48/0.51; CF n=17 bias 0.06 SD 0.16 CI -0.28/0.40; ES n=15 bias -0.04 SD 0.20 CI -0.48/0.41). Acceptability limit is consistently stated as +/-0.5 log10 throughout the report (accuracy profile sections, e.g. section 3.1.2.2 and Table 11).
